title: sdk got an upgrade today
summary: speech-to-text and media uploads are now built directly into the npm package. also taught the media service how to name files correctly on download, which is nice. step-3.5-flash is back in the routing pool too

highlights.title: SDK Upgrades: Audio & BYOP
highlights.text: The hive has ears. You can now run Whisper Speech-to-Text, handle media uploads, and let users spend their own Pollen credits directly through the SDK.

highlights.title: Step-3.5-Flash Available
highlights.text: `step-3.5-flash` is now wired up and ready for chat completions via the [Unified API](https://gen.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Media Storage Upgrades
highlights.text: Name tags for your files. Media downloads now preserve your original filenames, and re-uploading an existing file automatically resets its 14-day expiration timer.
